note: Satellite launch with no farming use stated for the country.

facts.fact: The Algerian Space Agency (ASAL) says it works with the Ministry of Agriculture on pilot satellite mapping of cereals (Sidi Bel Abbes, Sentinel-2 NDVI time series) and of potatoes (Mostaganem), and plans to customise CropWatch for these two pilot zones.

systems.owner: Agence Spatiale Algérienne with Ministry of Agriculture

facts.fact: The CGIAR tool series says the WaPOR-based Water Use Tool is used by the WaPOR Digital Unit at the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development, hosted by its Department of Statistics and Strategies, and uses 20 m WaPOR satellite data to compute dekadal irrigation water use and map irrigated and rainfed parcels, with a dashboard for the Mitidja West scheme.

systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (DSS)

facts.fact: Algeria's agriculture minister announced that from December 2022 a census of irrigated cereal perimeters would use satellite images, plus 100 drones in some wilayas.
facts.system: Satellite census of irrigated cereal perimeters

facts.fact: Algeria's agriculture minister and the space agency ASAL held a study day on 21 June 2020 to set a roadmap for using satellite images and maps to define farmland perimeters in the Saharan south, ASAL saying its imagery delimits cultivable land and groundwater.

Les Enjeux Eco reports the agriculture ministry's secretary general saying satellite imagery from the Algerian Space Agency let Algeria control the locust invasion, with 23,000 hectares treated preventively and eight field teams deployed in the south.

systems.owner: Algerian Space Agency with Ministry of Agriculture; shared with CLCPRO under a 2025-2030 accord

facts.fact: ASAL states that its first national conference on geospatial technologies for agriculture, held 29-30 November 2023 in Oran, heard presentations on ASAL's agriculture studies, Alsat-1B imagery to identify desert soils for farming, and the CropWatch crop-monitoring experience in Algeria.

note: Vigilance map mentioned for farmers; no satellite use in farming stated.
The document states nothing this study asks.

facts.fact: A steering committee of Sonatrach, the agriculture ministry, BNEDER and ENSA was installed, per ENSA, to monitor 30-hectare agricultural pivots using satellite observations alongside sensor measurements and field observations.

systems.system: Comite de pilotage for 30-hectare agricultural pivots
systems.owner: Sonatrach (Agroalimentaire Activites), ministry of agriculture, BNEDER, ENSA

facts.fact: A coordination meeting in Tiaret discussed the Algerian Space Agency's (ASAL) draft final report on satellite monitoring of crops, chiefly cereals, closing a project carried out with the agriculture ministry, which assessed monitoring of cultivated areas from satellite images with field visits in Medea, Tiaret and Ain Temouchent.

systems.owner: ASAL with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development

facts.fact: Echorouk reports that a project between Algeria's agriculture ministry and the Algerian Space Agency to set up a permanent satellite-imagery monitoring and evaluation mechanism for strategic farm sectors is under way, with ONILEV adopting a digital roadmap for it.
facts.system: Permanent satellite-imagery monitoring and evaluation mechanism for strategic farm sectors

facts.fact: FAO and CLCPRO say that on 2 February 2025 the Algerian Space Agency ASAL signed an MoU undertaking to supply CLCPRO with satellite data on areas conducive to Desert Locust development and to train national experts, for integration into CLCPRO's monitoring and alert mechanisms.

Independent Arabia reports on 18 March 2026 that Algeria's national locust response relies on an early-warning system supported by Algerian Space Agency satellite data, which identifies desert areas of temporary vegetation growth, under a plan reviewed by the Prime Minister's ministerial meeting.

systems.country_label: Desert locust early warning with ASAL data

facts.fact: The Algerian Space Agency was honoured by FAO for locating desert locust breeding sites with Alsat-1, Alsat-2A and Alsat-2B imagery and for a national platform combining field data and space analysis that serves national plant-protection services.
